text:
The easiest way to start a subscription audit is to stop looking at your bank statements and start looking at your email inbox instead. Search your mail for keywords like "subscription," "renew," or "receipt." 

This habit uncovers those forgotten monthly charges that often hide in the fine print of your transactions. Once you find them, don't just cancel—ask yourself if that service actually added value to your life this month. It’s the fastest way to reclaim your budget without the headache.
